easyPrerequisites: Oracle's Gift must have valid targets.
description:
Cast Oracle's Gift using the convoke ability from Party Thrasher by tapping Jadzi, Steward of Fate.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Jadzi, Steward of Fate, which enters prepared.
Resolve Oracle's Gift.
Repeat.

uses.name: Jadzi, Steward of Fate // Oracle's Gift
